title: Efficient and selective leaching of nickel and cobalt from nickel laterite ore by a combined atmospheric acid leaching-ferric chloride solution leaching process: optimization and mechanism
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29176-29189
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04469C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jingbei Li, Tong Yu, Chenyang Li, Xiao Han, Jianming Gao
A combined atmospheric acid leaching-ferric chloride solution leaching process was developed to leach cobalt and nickel selectively and efficiently over iron from nickeliferous laterite ores.
